temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley’s somber demeanor and hears Shirley say the loss has been tough and that she keeps thinking about whether more could have been done. Shirley says it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knew Shirley cared for the patient and suspected she was affected by the loss, but she did not yet know how deeply Shirley was grieving or whether Shirley felt responsible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara’s suspicion is confirmed and deepened. She learns Shirley is grieving, ruminating about whether more could have been done, and struggling to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is deeply affected by the patient’s death, may feel some responsibility or regret, and needs reassurance and support to process the loss.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort and reassure Shirley, validate the care they provided, and help her focus on good care and joyful moments.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara raises the topic of treatment decisions. Shirley says she feels responsible and wonders whether pushing for a different approach might have helped. Shirley appreciates Sara’s reassurance but says it is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Shirley is grieving, possibly feeling responsibility or regret, and needs reassurance and support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley’s sense of responsibility is confirmed and made explicit. Sara also learns that reassurance helps somewhat but does not fully resolve Shirley’s burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels responsible for the outcome, carries guilt or burden, and is struggling to accept that the team made the best decisions with the information available.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue talking with Shirley to alleviate her guilt, share the burden, and reassure her that the decisions were made with the information available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: In a quiet moment at the office, Sara observes that Shirley has continued reserved behavior and minimal emotional expression. Sara confronts her about holding back feelings. Shirley says she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak. Sara says expressing emotion does not make her weak and is healthy among friends. Shirley says Sara may be right and she will try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Shirley is still grieving and burdened by responsibility, and may be withdrawing or suppressing feelings. Sara believes Shirley may need to open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns Shirley has been holding back feelings because she fears appearing unprofessional or weak, and that Shirley is willing to try being more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is suppressing emotions due to fear of judgment, but she may be open to expressing them with encouragement in a safe friendship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to express her feelings, provide a safe and nonjudgmental space, and support her attempt to be more open.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong. Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well and appreciates the apology. Sara says she is there for Shirley in whatever way she needs. Shirley thanks her and says continuing to talk helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and could have strained the friendship. She wants to apologize and repair any damage.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley’s response reassures Sara that the apology is accepted, the relationship is intact, and Shirley values continued talks.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley accepts Sara’s apology, understands her good intentions, and finds their conversations helpful. Sara can continue supporting her without the earlier concern damaging their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Remain available and supportive, keep communication open, and be more sensitive while helping Shirley.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley seems improved. Shirley says she is feeling better thanks to their talks and Sara’s support. Sara offers to spend more time together outside work. Shirley agrees and suggests planning something for the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Shirley has been gradually opening up and benefiting from support, but Sara is not fully sure how much she has improved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara sees concrete improvement and learns that her support and their talks are helping. Shirley is also willing to deepen the friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is doing better, values Sara’s support, and is open to spending time together socially. Their friendship and communication are positively progressing.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley, plan weekend time together, and maintain the supportive friendship.
